citations.quote: mein Mann hat seit dem Frühling eine Nebenhöhlenentzündung nach der anderen, und der HNO-Arzt hat gefragt, ob wir Schimmel in der Wohnung haben
an der Decke im Bad ist grau-grüner Schimmel, und im Gang riecht es muffig.
dazu kommt, dass wir alle paar Tage am Morgen bei 15 Grad aufwachen, bis jemand im Keller den Brenner wieder startet
Wir sind uns nicht einig, darum muss jetzt ein Bauexperte die Ursache untersuchen, das verlange ich auch schriftlich
ich werde ab Dezember die Miete auf das Hinterlegungskonto einzahlen, wenn bis dann nichts passiert.

plan.because: Request the complete contract, including parties and all agreed terms; only page 2 is supplied.
Establish which defects were reported to the landlord and when.
Establish whether and when the landlord received the defect report.
Document the visible defects, locations and observation dates.
Document the landlord’s response, proposed work and access arrangements.
Mould is reported; dated observations can document conditions at the affected location.
Heating failures are reported; obtain the inspection date and service findings if available.
Health effects are reported; obtain findings and any limits on attributed cause without assuming causation.
A specialist investigation is requested and the cause is disputed; obtain any report or arrange referral as appropriate.
A rent deposit is contemplated; establish any communicated repair deadline and its recipient before assessing safeguards.
Optional under the process, although the caretaker’s reported observations may assist the investigation.

questions: Is anyone currently experiencing urgent health symptoms or unsafe indoor temperatures? Seek immediate medical or emergency assistance if needed.
When did the mould and heating problems begin, and which rooms and dates are affected?
When and how were the defects reported to the landlord, and what response or access arrangements followed?
Has a written repair deadline been communicated, and has a technical or heating inspection already taken place?
